const form = new FormData();
form.append("note", "hi");
form.append("doc", await openAsBlob("./a.pdf"), "a.pdf"); // openAsBlob is imported from node:fs
const response = await fetch("https://api.test/up", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    "X-A": "1"
  },
  body: form
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
